scope: Read-only static qualification of the exact repaired private capture derivative before Firefox acquisition. No browser was launched by this reviewer.

findings.description: The original de9fdf driver bracketed the third request dispatch, so a late JSON settlement or late consumer recovery could fall outside the pixel span while the check passed. Exact v1 bytes remain retained.

The repaired gate requires third request dispatch, its JSON settlement and the first subsequent passive eligible 24-degree/rain-on consumer in the recorded span, with at least two seconds after that consumer.

staticReview.diffFromQualifiedBase: Only the title, a six-second full-viewport native PNG sequence beginning at fixture elapsed 147 seconds, and the post-run recovery gate are added. The existing checkpoint path, 30-second sequence, cleanup and custody path are unchanged.
staticReview.window: First after-clock and its host receipt define the start. The last capture starts at or beyond both six-second endpoints; all prefix/suffix images remain retained.
staticReview.timingControls: At least 48 images, maximum 250 ms start gap and capture duration, six to eight seconds of fixture coverage, at least six seconds of host coverage, and per-capture native elapsed/wall agreement.
staticReview.observers: Only native performance/Date clocks are read during the added span. No public-clear wrapper, full QA publication read, render, acquisition, model installation or clock change occurs there. The fixture's existing passive ledger is inspected after capture.
staticReview.wholeImageCapture: Native 390x600 viewport; full_page=False, animations allowed, no clip/resize/settling wait. Original video remains independent evidence.

independentValidation.adapter: Use diagnostic before/after native clocks as beforeClock/afterClock; no values changed

limitations: This is preparation qualification, not a native run or a visual PASS.
The native screenshots are bounded call-time observations. They cannot exclude a sub-capture gap, identify every physical refresh, or replace failures in the original videos.
The six-second recovery span and new 30-second interval must each be reviewed from their actual retained pixels, and the exact driver, runtime and fixture must match this report.

An initial local control invocation used the old diagnostic schema's nonexistent beforeClock field and stopped with KeyError before gate execution. The corrected explicit before/after-to-clock adapter preserves all values; all five actual-gate controls then passed.
